shots.text: The Thunder Steppe is grassland on a high plateau. The Galeborn live there on horseback and steer by the storms. Its Warden, Aurath, sleeps in the storms themselves.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Endless high grass under a racing sky, standing stones, tent-cities, riders on grey horses.

shots.text: Aurath had gone mad, and the storms had stopped moving. Without them the Steppe could not keep out the earth. Walking stone climbed the cliffs, led by the Herald Gorrath.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A frozen, motionless sky. Armoured earth spirits climbing the plateau edge. At their head a giant Stoneborn general with a square hole in his chest: Gorrath.

shots.text: The Galeborn don't build walls. Your towers are the only walls they've got. Start at Stonering Camp.
shots.speaker: fennick
shots.art_note: Fennick on horseback, badly, holding his hat on, pointing at a camp of standing stones.
